name: tailzu-viewer
description: Tailzu artifact viewer: a Cloudflare Worker (Workers Static Assets) that serves the sandboxed page an artifact runs in. The artifact is compiled and shown on the person's own device.

scripts.test:worker: npm run build && vitest run --project worker
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && playwright test
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --var ENV:development
